crossRefs.note: I will send my terror before you, and will confuse all the people to whom you come, and I will make all your enemies…
Observe that which I command you today. Behold, I will drive out before you the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Hittite…
“Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall…
then Yahweh will drive out all these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess nations greater and mightier…
These are the inheritances which the children of Israel took in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua…
Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.
Now the name of Hebron before was Kiriath Arba, after the greatest man among the Anakim. Then the land had rest from…
Yahweh gave them rest all around, according to all that he swore to their fathers. Not a man of all their enemies stood…
Nothing failed of any good thing which Yahweh had spoken to the house of Israel. All came to pass.
Now Yahweh your God has given rest to your brothers, as he spoke to them. Therefore now return and go to your tents, to…
After many days, when Yahweh had given rest to Israel from their enemies all around, and Joshua was old and well…
He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the…
I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.
From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on…
For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.
There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that Yahweh spoke to Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance to Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. Then the land had rest from war.
translations.bsb: So Joshua took the entire land, in keeping with all that the LORD had spoken to Moses. And Joshua gave it as an inheritance to Israel according to the allotments to their tribes. Then the land had rest from war.
translations.kjv: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the LORD said unto Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land rested from war.
translations.asv: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that Jehovah spake unto Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land had rest from war.
